producer_report.summary: The reader brief now prints the recorded deliverable count on the "Allowed change scope, deliverables" line, so the reader copies it and no longer counts. The line reads "(N recorded, copy this number, do not count)", where N is `reading_deliverables.len()`. `referenced_jobs_section` chains into `prior_result_section`, so this one edit covers retried jobs and named jobs. A job with 0 deliverables keeps the existing "none recorded for it" line. I added one test and a CHANGELOG Fixed entry. No refusal rule was added.

checks_run.note: 132 passed, including the new test and a_follow_up_brief_carries_the_result_and_scope_of_each_named_job.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs builds a reader brief for a follow-up whose carried job records 11 deliverables and asserts the text contains the count 11 next to 'Allowed change scope, deliverables' for that job, and a second job with 3 deliverables shows 3. Run `cargo test -p athena-context brief`; it fails on base, where no count is printed.
criteria_check.evidence: The new test the_brief_prints_the_recorded_deliverable_count_for_every_carried_job passes under `cargo test -p athena-context`. It asserts "deliverables (11 recorded" for one carried job and "deliverables (3 recorded" for another. On base no count is printed, so those assertions would fail. I did not run it against base.

criteria_check.criterion: The count is computed from reading_deliverables.len() for every job in prior_result_section and in referenced_jobs_section, not typed per job: a test with differing lengths (0, 1, 11) shows each count, and 0 still prints the existing 'none recorded' line. Run `cargo test -p athena-context`.
criteria_check.evidence: The count is `prior.reading_deliverables.len()` in the loop in reader.rs. The same test covers lengths 1 (earlier_attempt), 11, 3 and 0 (referenced_jobs). The 0 case asserts "deliverables: none recorded for it". `cargo test -p athena-context` passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep of the diff shows only crates/athena-context/src/briefs/reader.rs, crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs and CHANGELOG.md changed; crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, reading/topics.rs, reading/checks.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs, refusal_corpus.rs and all prompt files are unchanged, and no new step! or check function appears in refusing_check.
criteria_check.evidence: I edited only those three files. No athena-core, retry.rs, refusal_corpus.rs or prompt file was touched.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md Unreleased has an entry that names the cause (reader had to count a bare deliverable list and miscounted, e.g. 12 for 11 in job 7zqw) and says the fix prints the recorded count; it does not list fzx0 or bn3c as instances. Check with Grep.
criteria_check.evidence: The new `### Fixed` entry under Unreleased names the bare list, the miscount (12 for 11 in 7zqw) and the printed recorded count. It does not mention fzx0 or bn3c.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass, and existing tests such as a_follow_up_brief_carries_the_result_and_scope_of_each_named_job still pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for clippy and the full test run. I ran `cargo fmt --all --check` (clean) and `cargo test -p athena-context`, where a_follow_up_brief_carries_the_result_and_scope_of_each_named_job passes.
